note: Single-turn plan coverage through the chief-dispatch runner. Cases ask chief to write a plan as persisted todos; grading reads todo title+spec only (assistant prose does not count). expect.kind must be plan. include is alias groups (any alias in a group hits; every group must hit). exclude is forbidden. minSplits/maxSplits are inclusive bounds on the number of persisted plan cards (ADR 0024: split when work is independent; keep a single card for single-view single-artifact work).

roster.description: Owns reader-facing docs: README, tutorials, changelogs. Does not change product code.
Owns server, daemon, and shared package implementation and fixes. Does not own UI layout.
Owns apps/web layout, components, and client behavior. Does not own backend APIs.
Owns CI, packaging, deploy config, and local tooling. Does not implement product features.

cases.prompt: Export button does nothing on Safari. Write a plan that finds the cause in the client download path and covers verification. Keep it as one card: this is a single-view single-artifact fix.

Ship an export feature end to end: add a server export endpoint, wire the web export button, and document the user steps. These are independent deliverables across server, web, and docs, so split the plan into separate cards.
